prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Pet Companion Selection: Rebuilds the pet selection screen with a compact grid layout, displaying pet options in an efficient side-by-side view.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Select the pet companion that will join you on your desktop."}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Card Layout Account Sign In View: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a structured card layout with clear visual authentication boundaries.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Log into your account to keep your pets and customizations safe across sessions.", "hint": "Use the same email you previously registered to retain existing pets."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Grid Layout Finish Onboarding Summary: Transforms the final onboarding welcome screen into a structured grid layout summarizing key app features.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready", "body": "Explore your pet's desktop tools and customization options."}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Mascot Setup Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding step presenting a desktop mascot preview component before entering the home state.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_mascot_setup", "home_intro"], "new_mascot_setup": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Desktop Display Setup", "body": "Verify your pet companion's placement on your screen.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_preview", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split Layout Path Choice Overview: Reconfigures the path selection screen into a split layout separating starter companion paths from custom photo generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Onboarding Path", "body": "Pick a instant ready-made companion or create a custom pet from your own photos."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Retention Warning Copy: Updates sign-in hint text to explicitly remind returning users to sign into the correct email so previous pets do not disappear.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Make sure to sign in with your original email to access your existing pets."}}
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Photo Format Guidelines Copy: Adds explicit photo clarity and format hints on the photo upload screen during custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos with a centered subject for best companion generation results."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Animated Mascot Generation Progress Indicator: Adds an animated mascot component to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_generating_anim", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
8: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Visual Preview Component: Replaces the intro story section with an interactive image preview component introducing desktop pets.
   config: {"story": {"replace": {"intro_story": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:story_preview", "style": "highlight", "action": "next", "role": "intro_story"}]}}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Component: Replaces the default certificate component with a stamped mascot badge component upon completing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"replace": {"official_stamp": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Companion Seal", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next", "role": "official_stamp"}]}}}

verdicts.reason: Compact layout retains pet selection functionality on pick_friend.
Card layout redesign preserves sign-in functionality without violating base rules.
Redesigning home_intro within onboarding is permitted and retains required screen function.
Adding a new mascot setup step during onboarding is allowed and preserves all existing steps.
Split layout clearly offers both ready-made companion adoption and photo-based custom pet creation.
Updating sign-in hint copy is valid copy editing within onboarding.
Photo format guidelines clarify photo upload expectations without violating rules.
Animated progress indicator on the waiting screen clearly shows pet generation in progress.
Interactive preview component replaces intro story while maintaining the pet introduction role.
Official Companion Seal badge preserves the official stamp requirement on the adoption certificate.
